meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 为机器人接入 Slack 频道：复制并注册 Slack 适配器、安装 @chat-adapter/slack，带你创建 Slack 应用并填入令牌，重启服务后即可在 Slack 频道或私信里跟它对话。
howto.when: 当你要求给机器人接入 Slack 频道时触发，可独立运行，也可在 /setup 流程中调用；每个步骤都可重复运行。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 接入这个机器人
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖，并引导你创建 Slack 应用。

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接入 Slack
say.note: 选 Socket Mode，不需要公网地址。

say.text: 我的 Slack 回复收不到，帮我排查
say.note: 会检查事件订阅和 App Home 的消息标签页设置。

howto.what_en: Adds Slack support to your bot: copies and registers the Slack adapter, installs @chat-adapter/slack, walks you through creating a Slack app and pasting tokens, then restarts the service so you can chat in Slack channels or DMs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Slack channel integration; it can run on its own or as part of /setup, and every step is safe to re-run.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dependency, and guides app creation.
Socket Mode needs no public URL.

say_en.text: My Slack replies never arrive - help me debug
say_en.note: Checks event subscriptions and the App Home Messages Tab.
